==Quests==
Talk to Cilin Spellsinger in the [[Plane of Sky]].

You say, 'hail Cilin Spellsinger'
:''Cilin Spellsinger says 'Greetings %t.  Do you feel that you are ready to be tested in song?''
You say, 'I am ready to be tested in song'
:''Cilin Spellsinger says 'The tests of song hold both joy and sorrow.  Choose with whom you wish to begin, Denise or Clarisa. ''

= Denise Songweaver =

You say, 'I choose Denise'
:''Cilin Spellsinger says 'Return this tome if you wish me to summon Denise Songweaver to assist you. Destroy it if you do not. ''
:''Cilin Spellsinger says 'Farewell. ''
:''Denise Songweaver says 'Rejoice and sing my friend. ''
You say, 'hail Denise Songweaver'
:''Denise Songweaver says 'Hi there %t!  I give three sections of the test of songs, Clarisa does the rest. ''
:''Do you wish to take the test of pitch, voice, or tone or have you come for trade? ''
You say, 'I have come for trade'
:''Denise Songweaver says 'I am looking to trade back for the Mask of the Songbird, Songweaver's Mantle or Agilmente's Flute of Flight that I gave out long ago.  I have few things that will be of more use to someone then those inferior quality items.' ''

== Bard Test of Pitch ==

You say, 'I wish to take the test of pitch'
:''Denise Songweaver says 'The pitch that we sing and play has a great effect on those who listen.  Keep this in mind, and you shall always be welcome in taverns and inns.  Now, I need you to return to me a phosphoric globe, a shimmering diamond, and a crude wooden flute.''

'''Reward:''' {{:Ervaj's Flute of Flight}}

! Item || Who || Where

|-
| [[Shimmering Diamond]] || [[a soul carrier]], [[an essence carrier]], [[a soul tamer]], [[an essence tamer]] || Island 4
|-
| [[Crude Wooden Flute]] || [[The Spiroc Lord]] || Island 5 Boss
|}

== Bard Test of Voice ==

You say, 'I wish to take the test of voice'
:''Denise Songweaver says 'The sweet sounds rising forth from our throats are what make us truly great.  Go forth and give voice to your songs, and return to me a platinum disc, a music box, and a light woolen mantle.  If you do this, I shall give you the songweaver's mantle.  Good luck!''

'''Reward:''' {{:Mantle of the Songweaver}}

{| class="eoTable3"
! Item || Who || Where
|-
| [[Platinum Disc]] || [[an azarack]] || Island 2
|-
| [[Music Box]] || [[a gorgalask]], [[a watchful guard]], [[a spirited harpie]], [[an avenging gazer]] || Island 3
|-
| [[Light Woolen Mantle]] || [[Keeper of Souls]] || Island 4 Boss
|}


== Bard Test of Tone ==

You say, 'I wish to take the test of tone'

''Denise Songweaver says, 'Tone is important to all singers.  Prove to me that you can keep your tone even and pure by bringing me an ochre tessera, a songbird statuette, and a light woolen mask.  If you do this, I will give you the mask of the songbird.''

'''Reward:''' {{:Mask of Song}}

{| class="eoTable3"
! Item || Who || Where
|-
| [[Ochre Tessera]] || [[a thunder spirit]] || Island 1
|-
| [[Songbird Statuette]] || [[Protector of Sky]] || Island 2 Boss
|-
| [[Light Woolen Mask]] || [[Gorgalosk]] || Island 3 Boss
|}

= Clarisa Spiritsong =

You say, 'I choose Clarisa'
:''Cilin Spellsinger says 'Take this book of melodies and read.  When you are done, I will summon Clarisa so you can begin your test. ''
:''Cilin Spellsinger says 'Farewell. ''
:''Clarisa Spiritsong says 'Rejoice and sing my friend. ''
You say, 'hail Clarisa Spiritsong'
:''Clarisa Spiritsong says 'Hail and well met %t!  I give the second half of the tests of song.  If you are ready, choose from among  the tests of brass, wind, and harmony. ''

== Bard Test of Brass ==

You say, 'I choose the tests of brass'
:''Clarisa Spiritsong says 'Then bring back to me an efreeti war horn, a saffron spiroc feather, adamantium bands, and a glowing diamond.'' 

'''Reward:''' {{:Denon's Horn of Disaster}}
